reviews.t: Cute stickers, great for sealing 'thank you' cards.
reviews.x: The stickers are cute and perfect for using to close envelopes for "thank you" cards without having to lick the envelopes. Two stickers were damaged (one had the seller's logo stuck over it and the first sticker on the roll was cut in half). Luckily there are at least a couple hundred other stickers on the roll (I don't have time to count to confirm it's 498 left, lol) so I'm not concerned or upset, it just didn't make for great presentation on the seller's part.Still a pretty good produ

These are adorable and perfect in size, a nice generous size where your THANK YOU won't be missed.  Gives such a nice touch to clear cellophane treat bags which I use for jewelry.  Don't be surprised if I am a repurchase again and again.

Very happy with my purchase, the quality and quantity of these stickers is very well worth the price - its a great deal. I am going to use these to add an extra cute touch to the outside of all our thank you cards from our upcoming baby shower. With this roll size I will no doubt be using these for a long time to come.
Love them. They are cute and it's great for the price. Definitely worth the price. Must buy.
They don't reliably hold a standard kraft paper envelope closed for mailing. Disappointed!

Are use the stickers to place on back of envelopes I mail out for thank you cards or other notes. The size is great and the writing style on the sticker is nice. The package comes in a large quantity so I doubt I will need to buy some anytime soon overall this is a great product

These are great stickers for the price!  I've noticed they're easy to tear if you're not careful,  but as long as you pull up from the bottom of the heart, it's ok.  I'm still very happy with the quantity I received for the price.  I use these to ship my eBay items.
I love these stickers, they are so cute. But they aren't very sticky and don't stay stuck to my products I sell.

reviews.t: It was perfect to say thank you in my wedding favors
reviews.x: It was perfect to say thank you in my wedding favors. It is very sticky and It's easy to handle.
Perfect for the many packages I send every week.  Great price and the look good.
Numerous amounts of stickers that will last me forever

This is my best wedding purchase yet. They are cute and you get so so so many!!!! I've used these on my guest favors, my bridal shower thank you cards, and even my hotel bags and I still have a lot left over. Don't hesitate to buy these!!!!!! I even bought the happily ever after ones for my save the dates and wedding invitations. I even wrote with a sharpie on the thank you sticker on our hotel bags.

reviews.t: Great Value, I will repurchase & would recommend!
reviews.x: These are half the size I expected them to be (just looking at the photo) the measurements within the listing are accurate. I’m happy with them & They fit perfectly besides my buyers address on their shipping label. The adhesive is great & simplicity of the natural look is just what I was looking for. Great Value, I will repurchase & would recommend!

Sometimes I sell clothes online. These stickers are much more convenient and cost effective than including a thank-you card or note, but I think they convey the same message to my buyers. They are good quality. Sometimes I’ve ripped them if I try to peel from the top, but if I peel them off the roll starting at the pointed bottom I have no issues.

reviews.t: Subtle way of showing you care
reviews.x: I purchased these stickers to show my gratitude towards customers in their packages. Super cute “craft paper” style sticker with tasteful calligraphy writing.  The stickers come rolled up and perfectly presented. I had zero issues removing them and placing them onto some tissue paper.

The roll of stickers ends on a sticker ripped in half and also has a different sticker holding the roll closed and thus sticking to another sticker so that it can’t be used so don’t count on having exactly 150 count if that’s what you need, but they are still cute and good quality.

reviews.t: Love love love these thank you stickers!
reviews.x: Love these envelope stickers! These are really great quality and price. They really dress up your envelope when sending thank you cards. Perfect for every day thank you cards or for more formal situations like weddings or baby shower thank you cards. I love them!

These are the perfect touch for thank you card envelopes. I didn't realize I had ordered 500! But I have seriously challenged myself to give them all away! The first couple were unusable due to packaging and opening, but I really considered that a non-issue.

reviews.t: Great way to show your gratitude
reviews.x: I am very pleased with the quality of these Thank You Stickers. I like the Kraft paper & I think they are a nice touch to add to my shipments to different clients. They stick very well & just look nice. I would recommend these to anyone.

I use these to add onto plastic bags for reselling on Poshmark and so far they stick well. I did try them on tissue paper and were not sticking good enough, they do not hold if you want to use for tissue paper. I would purchase again!

Cute and nostalgic. Brown paper heart stickers on a roll. Use them for whatever you'd like. We use ours to seal little gift bads at our camp store. A great way to seal an evelope or bag and to say thank you to customers all in one.
Love my stickers and are the perfect touch on a thank you card! Also good for sticking on a desk to thank a co-worker for their assistance. No problems with seller and would order from them again!

reviews.t: They are small enough for the envelopes I purchased and gave the favors a nice handmade rustic look
reviews.x: Item just as described. Worked perfectly for babyshower seed packet thank you gifts. They are small enough for the envelopes I purchased and gave the favors a nice handmade rustic look.
These do the job. I like to use them instead of tape to close packages I wrap for my customers. I would say they’re just a little bit bigger than a quarter. Great quality for the price

reviews.t: A wonderful way to say thanks to "tippers"
reviews.x: These were great for my little coffee shop. I stuck them on the coffee cups of my tippers! They have a look and feel like they're eco-friendly and made with natural materials.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the stickers as cute and a nice touch for thank-you cards, envelopes, and packages.
Many reviewers consider the stickers a great value given the large quantity and low price.
A few reviewers report the stickers are not very sticky and may not reliably hold envelopes or products.
Some reviewers note the stickers can tear or be damaged if not peeled carefully.
Several reviewers mention repurchasing or recommending the stickers.
